wiki.extract: Manovo-Gounda St Floris National Park is a national park and UNESCO World Heritage Site located in the Central African Republic prefecture Bamingui-Bangoran, near the Chad border. It was inscribed to the list of World Heritage Sites in 1988 as a result of the diversity of life present within it.
Boali became the capital city of Ombella-M'Poko prefecture in Central African Republic on December 10 2020 after the former capital of Bimbo was incorporated into Bangui prefecture.

The Dzanga-Sangha Special Reserve is a protected area in southwestern Central African Republic, covering 6,865.54 km2 (2,650.80 sq mi) of tropical rainforest within the Congo Basin. Established in 1990, it surrounds Dzanga-Ndoki National Park, together forming the Dzanga-Sangha Complex of Protected Areas.

food_writeup: Central African cuisine features staples like cassava, plantains, and rice, often accompanied by sauces made from peanuts, palm nuts, or vegetables. Fish and game meats are common protein sources.
brief_history: The Central African Republic gained independence from France in 1960. Since then, it has experienced political instability, coups, and conflicts involving various armed groups.

important_people.name: Barthélemy Boganda (founding father and first Prime Minister)

current_conflicts: Ongoing internal conflicts involving government forces and multiple rebel groups, leading to humanitarian challenges and displacement.
